decision: scoped the night to the six locally-provable units of the first vertical path
why: slices.md orders local workerd proof before paid deployment, and deploys are an always-pause action

decision: captured the baseline before touching anything
why: so every later verify reads as old value vs new value

decision: dropped the content-addressed digest and mount key from U1
why: ADR-0027 is human-approved and forbids both; the arena note that proposed them is evidence, not a decision
result: U1 rewritten, loader name derives from the labeled commit alone

decision: kept validation as a local ok/problem union instead of pulling in better-result
why: the repo's own adoption skill gates that dependency on the user approving a named slice, and no approval exists

decision: landed the module-map artifact and routed the fixture facet through it
why: a generation is several modules, and the supervisor has to reject a malformed one before it mounts anything
evidence: commits 55e0dbb and the ADR commit, test/agent/loader.test.ts

decision: added two checks the delegate had missed
why: it proved loading through getEntrypoint only, so nothing showed a multi-module artifact mounting as a facet, and nothing covered ADR-0027's cached-name reuse
result: both pass, reuse of a labeled commit returns its first code

decision: landed supervisor-owned generation state in Durable Object SQLite
why: ADR-0003 gives the supervisor sole authority over it and every later unit reads it

decision: parsed the harness commit at the RPC boundary instead of storing whatever string arrived
why: the delegate stored raw strings, so labelGeneration('main') would have created a generation
result: malformed commits now rejected, U1 parse shared by both callers

decision: made a preparation outcome terminal per generation, rejecting a later contradicting check
why: the delegate silently no-opped it, which discards a real event on a labeled commit that ADR-0002 says must be recorded
result: OPEN, no ADR yet, U5's evidence ledger may derive status instead

decision: landed the startup check as one bounded ordinary request and recorded it as ADR-0029
why: slices.md forbids turning the check into a permanent facet protocol, and the arena prototype had done exactly that

decision: raised the default deadline from 50ms to 5s and made the hanging test pass its own
why: 50ms was tuned so the test suite stayed fast, and shipping it would have failed every real cold start
result: default is now a plainly chosen bound, still unmeasured

decision: deleted the heuristic that read workerd error text to tell a mount failure from a startup failure
why: it matched on the prefix 'Failed to start Worker:', so a runtime wording change would have silently misclassified failures
result: anything failing before headers is now one stage carrying the runtime's own message

decision: left the mount-failed stage in the union with no test covering it
why: it only fires if facets.get itself throws, which nothing local can trigger

decision: landed checked, epoch-bound, journaled generation requests and recorded ADR-0030
why: ADR-0003 requires the supervisor to validate every request and perform or reject it alone

decision: kept the request transport and principal authentication out of scope
why: the platform limits how a facet can hold a capability and no local evidence picks a transport, so building one would settle an open question by implication
result: OPEN, nothing authenticates a principal yet

decision: did not make activation swap the facet serving traffic
why: that needs the supervisor to hold artifact bytes across a restart, and artifact storage is open under ADR-0027 and ADR-0028

decision: landed the relay fact ledger and derived known-good eligibility, recorded as ADR-0031
why: the design documents insist a status is not evidence a streamed turn completed, and nothing was observing that

decision: stopped a refused preparation check from writing an evidence row
why: a rejected check left a passing row behind, which could have started a fresh evidence era for a generation whose status never moved

decision: left caller cancellation proved only as a pending attempt, not as a propagated cancel
why: neither an aborted request nor a cancelled response body reached the facet through the Durable Object binding locally, which matches what the earlier paid probe saw

decision: used a declared-length truncation to prove a 200 that fails mid-body
why: a genuine upstream stream error produced an unhandled workerd rejection that would have destabilised the suite
result: property proved, by a narrower mechanism than a real stream error

decision: landed bounded recovery with an evidence-backed fallback, recorded as ADR-0032
why: slices.md step 6 asks for a bounded return to a known-good generation with a recovery report

decision: generalised eligibility from the active generation to any generation's latest evidence era
why: recovery has to judge a generation that is not running, and the U5 shape returned not-active for every one of them, so no fallback could ever qualify

decision: split the activation era off the protected-state epoch after proving they interfered
why: one counter served ADR-0030 staleness and ADR-0031 evidence eras, so labeling an unrelated commit discarded a running generation's credit
evidence: test/supervisor/evidence-era.test.ts, written failing first at 1 of 3 credited turns

decision: committed that clock fix inside the U6 commit rather than its own
why: it was found and fixed mid-unit and the run policy asks for out-of-band fixes to be separate
result: deviation from the run's own rule, recorded not hidden

decision: supersedes the U1 row: its commit hash 55e0dbb does not exist, the real commits are fe8ca75 and e321a01
why: I wrote the hash from memory before committing instead of reading it back, and the end-of-run audit caught it
evidence: git cat-file -t 55e0dbb returns not a valid object name
result: corrected, every other logged hash resolves

decision: checked the run against its own rules
why: an unattended run has to prove it kept its constraints, not assert it
evidence: README.md untouched, no test file deleted, no push, 63 tests up from 5, pre-commit verify ran on all 9 commits

decision: a cross-family reviewer read the trail and the diff, and three of its five findings were real
why: same-family self-review does not catch this class of thing, so the run's rules require fresh eyes

decision: wrote the serving gap and the streamed-truncation gap into ADR-0031 instead of only the decision log
why: the ADRs read as if eligibility said something about a generation, when traffic is still served by the fixture and an early stream close is credited as complete

decision: pinned the era-reset behaviour with a test that names it rather than leaving it invisible
why: the existing no-op test compared a payload that cannot see a new check id, so a redundant check silently zeroing credit passed unnoticed
result: OPEN, whether re-admission should need re-activation is the user's call

decision: closed unchecked Supervisor mutation RPCs, cancellation persistence corruption, and stale epochs after evidence writes
why: the full review found three correctness faults that undermined protected state and retained evidence
result: VERIFIED, public regressions and full gate

decision: made raw relay facts authoritative and refined HarnessCommit and GenerationLabel at boundaries
why: U5 and U2 implementations did not match their explicit contracts

decision: completed keyed recovery startup checks and made recovery states discriminated
why: U6 omitted its startup-check stage and allowed contradictory phase/result/operation combinations
result: VERIFIED, adversarial cross-family review and 119-test full gate

decision: fixed trailing-surrogate recovery errors and restored 64-hex Git object IDs
why: final standards review found one remaining runtime exception and one accidental compatibility narrowing

decision: scoped epoch to generation-control state and pinned observations, journals, and recovery writes as non-epoch changes
why: incrementing epoch on every turn would let mutable traffic starve activation; only state read by activation and rollback belongs in its compare-and-swap version
